import importlib.metadata
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root=Path(sys.argv[1])
root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
commands={
    "gpu":["nvidia-smi","--query-gpu=name,driver_version,memory.total","--format=csv,noheader"],
    "nvcc":["nvcc","--version"],
    "gxx":["g++","--version"],
    "nht_torch":["/root/.local/share/uv/tools/nht/bin/python","-c","import torch; print(torch.__version__); print(torch.version.cuda)"],
    "nht_commit":["git","-C","third_party/nht","rev-parse","HEAD"],
    "repository_commit":["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]}
result={}
for name,argv in commands.items():
    command=subprocess.run(argv,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
    result[name]={"argv":argv,"stdout":command.stdout,"stderr":command.stderr,"returncode":command.returncode}
result["numpy"]=importlib.metadata.version("numpy")
result["scipy"]=importlib.metadata.version("scipy")
p=root/"environment.partial"
p.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")
p.rename(root/"environment.json")
